mapper.sql: id, patient_id, metric_type, primary_value, secondary_value, measure_context, source_type, measured_at, created_by_user_id, remark, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO health_metric_record ( patient_id, metric_type, primary_value, secondary_value, measure_context, source_type, measured_at, created_by_user_id, remark, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{patientId}, #{metricType}, #{primaryValue}, #{secondaryValue}, #{measureContext}, #{sourceType}, #{measuredAt}, #{createdByUserId}, #{remark}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE health_metric_record SET metric_type = #{metricType}, primary_value = #{primaryValue}, secondary_value = #{secondaryValue}, measure_context = #{measureContext}, source_type = #{sourceType}, measured_at = #{measuredAt}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND patient_id = #{patientId} AND is_deleted = 0
